senses.gloss:
चिह्न चिह्न (probably for चिख्न, from a reduplicated form of खन् by the aff. अ), n.
 1. A mark of any kind, Rām. 4, 12, 44.
 2. Insignia, Ragh. 2, 7.
 3. An attribute, Bhāg. P. 4, 15, 9. []
 4. A sign, Pañc. i. d. 193.
 5. Caracter, Bhāg. P. 3, 32, 35.

चिह्नय चिह्नय (a denomin. derived from the last by अय), Par. To mark, Man. 8, 352.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To mark, Rām. 4, 42, 12.
 --With उपरि उपरि, उपरिचिह्नित, Signed above, Yājñ. 1, 318.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To mark, MBh. 3, 12445.
 2. To sign, Yājñ. 2, 93.
